pl-l4d1c3-d1e112.summary: Defines a sign, after Augustine, as a thing that, beyond the appearance it presents to the senses, makes something else come into thought from itself.
claims: A sign makes something other than itself come to mind.

pl-l4d1c3.summary: Defines a sign with Augustine: a thing that, beyond the appearance it presents to the senses, makes something else come to mind.
claims: A sign brings something else to mind beyond what it presents to the senses.
